alternatives.option: Make identity init also write repo_id
alternatives.reason_rejected: Fixes only new stores; every existing identity-init store.json in the field would still read as derived, and the shared-store semantics (one repo_ids list, first declared wins) would gain a second source of truth to keep in sync.

alternatives.option: Keep the derived fallback and leave the annex misreporting (the D51 disposition)
alternatives.reason_rejected: D51 deferred it only because the change was outside that lane's remit; the migrate-after-init overwrite is a data-integrity defect, not a cosmetic one.

context: Fixed store.json readers to accept identity-init's repo_ids-only shape: readStoreIdentity, v3-forward resolveIdentity and migrateStatus now fall back to repo_ids[0], so an identity-init v3 store reads as format 3 / source store.json and migrate reuses its ids.
rationale: identity init (ensureStoreDescriptor) writes {store_id, repo_ids, format, created_at} with no repo_id; only migrate finalize writes both. Reading only repo_id made the RetrievalAnnex report an identity-init v3 store as format 2 / derived-from-path while every event the runtime minted cited repo_ids[0] (repoIdFor), and let migrate run AFTER identity init mint a path-seeded store_id/repo_id and overwrite store.json, orphaning ids the ceremony membership and events already cited. First-declared-wins matches repoIdFor exactly, so the gate and the events now agree on scope.repo. This is the dedicated fix the D51 implementer deferred as out of remit (warning 01M2P189ZBYBFAKPNV0G2X2AHH); it deliberately flips the annex's repo_identity_source/format for identity-init stores from derived to minted, which is the correct reading.
summary: Chose to fix readStoreIdentity, resolveIdentity and migrateStatus to fall back to repo_ids[0] when repo_id is absent (repo_id still preferred when present), reporting source 'store.json' and the file's format
